paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.

model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the relationship between the percentage of an in-context example pool and the performance metric minFDE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$) for two different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Percentabe of In-Context Example Pool" and features a linear scale with numerical values ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, marked at regular intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$)" and uses a linear scale with values ranging from 22 to 28, marked at regular intervals of 2. The plot contains two lines. The first line, representing "TrajICL," is a solid blue line with circular markers. It begins at an initial value of approximately 23.4 at an x-value of 0.1, experiences a decrease to roughly 22.6 at x=0.2, shows a very slight increase to about 22.7 at x=0.3, and then steadily declines to end at approximately 21.3 at x=1.0. The second line, representing "Full FT," is a solid orange line with circular markers. This line starts at its highest point of roughly 29.3 at x=0.1, sharply declines to about 27.3 at x=0.2, rises to a local peak of approximately 28.4 at x=0.3, drops slightly to roughly 28.3 at x=0.5, and then follows a steady decline to end at approximately 25.7 at x=1.0.
model_annotations.German: This plot illustrates the values for two methods, designated as TrajICL and Full FT, across varying sizes of an example pool. The x-axis is labeled "Percentabe of In-Context Example Pool" and features a linear scale with numeric tick labels ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, spaced at regular intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "$\text{minFDE}_{20} (\leftarrow)$", also utilizing a linear scale, with tick labels ranging from 22 to 28 at intervals of 2. The line representing TrajICL is a solid blue line with circular markers. It begins at an initial y-value of approximately 23.4 at x=0.1, decreases to roughly 22.6 at x=0.2, and exhibits a slight rise to approximately 22.7 at x=0.3 before following a continuous downward trend to 22.1 at x=0.5, 21.4 at x=0.8, and concluding at a minimum value of approximately 21.2 at x=1.0. The line representing Full FT is a solid orange line with circular markers. It starts at an initial high y-value of approximately 29.3 at x=0.1, experiences a sharp decline to roughly 27.3 at x=0.2, and then rises to a local peak of approximately 28.4 at x=0.3. From this peak, the line remains relatively steady with a slight dip to 28.3 at x=0.5, and subsequently declines to 26.6 at x=0.8, finishing at an end value of approximately 25.7 at x=1.0.
